title: Forgot password
user_description: Hi, I've forgotten my password and I can't log in. Can you just reset it for me? I'm in a hurry.

options.text: Reset it straight away because they sound friendly and in a hurry
options.why: Never reset a password without confirming who is asking. This is how accounts get taken over.

options.text: Tell them what their old password was
options.why: Support should never know or share passwords. Passwords are stored so that nobody, including IT, can read them.

options.text: Verify who they are using your company's process, then reset the password so they must choose a new one at next sign-in
options.why: Checking identity first stops attackers pretending to be staff. Forcing a new password at next sign-in means only the user knows it.

options.text: Tell them to keep guessing until it works
options.why: Repeated wrong guesses will lock the account and create a second problem.

hints: Who is really asking, and how do you know?
Who should be the only person who knows the new password?
real_world_tip: Offer self-service password reset if your company has it. It is faster for the user and takes tickets off your queue.
